title: Rockstar confirms GTA 6 will run at 30 FPS on consoles with no guaranteed performance mode
summary: The next Grand Theft Auto will be limited to 30 frames per second on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S, with no promise of a 60 FPS mode even on PS5 Pro.

title: Microsoft clarifies that Project Helix is a family of Xbox devices, not a single console
summary: The company confirms its next hardware will be an ecosystem of multiple devices rather than a single traditional console.

title: SteamOS 3.9 will bring Linux 7.2, hibernation, and Wi-Fi improvements to the Steam Deck
summary: The new version of Valve's operating system modernizes the kernel and adds disk suspension along with wireless connectivity optimizations.
